_README: Provenance for the vendored CRD schemas in this directory. The files are byte-identical copies of the controller-gen output in nanohype/eks-agent-platform at the pinned ref below — never hand-edit them. `npm run schemas:crds` rewrites them from that ref; `npm run schemas:crds:check` is the CI gate. To adopt a newer operator API, bump `ref` and re-run the sync.
